records.name: m8-pancreatic-islet-v1
records.prompt: Scientific educational plate for Year 12 glucose regulation. Create ONE microscopic human pancreatic islet of Langerhans in natural history cutaway, isolated on genuine transparent alpha. Fine dark ink outlines with layered watercolour washes, matching anatomical teaching plates, no photorealism. Rounded pale cluster of endocrine cells surrounded by several darker pink berry-like exocrine acini and tiny ducts. In the HUMAN islet show many soft teal beta cells and fewer warm amber alpha cells INTERMIXED throughout, both central and peripheral, not a beta core with alpha mantle. Each cell has a visible nucleus and fine granules. A single small branching red capillary containing a few red blood cells runs through the cluster. No decorative extra circles. Keep whole tissue slice as a compact oval island surrounded by at least 12 percent clear margin on square canvas. No text, labels, arrows, symbols, people, hands, faces, paper background, coloured halo or cast shadow. Clear legible cell colours, not overly dense. Background fully transparent.

records.name: m8-muscle-cell-transporters-inside-v1
records.prompt: Scientific educational microscopy cutaway plate for insulin action. ONE short segment of ONE skeletal muscle fibre, not a whole muscle or bundle, shown horizontally with cylindrical red-pink striated surface, near left end cut transversely to show densely packed myofibrils. Along upper front side a broad cutaway window shows the pink cytoplasm just beneath the thin sarcolemma (cell membrane), so location of transporters is immediately clear. In this intracellular window show four round pale green membrane-bound storage vesicles; each vesicle membrane contains several small dark teal paired-pegs proteins, GLUT4 carriers, with closed surfaces NOT open holes. On the outer cell membrane show exactly three small separate Y-shaped dark blue insulin receptors and almost no teal GLUT4 carriers. A slender capillary containing exactly three red blood cells lies alongside and ABOVE the fibre, outside it, distinct from the fibre. Natural history plate style, fine dark ink outlines, layered watercolor washes, same anatomical teaching style as existing skeletal muscle plate. Clean transparent alpha background, compact centered composition on square canvas with at least 12 percent clear margin each side. No labels, text, arrows, numbers, people, hands, faces, glucose dots, shadow, glow, nonspecific open pores or labels. The vesicles belong clearly INSIDE cell beneath membrane, receptors outside. This is pre-insulin transporter INSIDE state for a future perfectly aligned paired edit.
